attchmntText: VLS Finance Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: VLS Finance Limited approved un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The board meeting was held on 13th November 2026. Statutory auditors Agiwal and Associates issued an unmodified opinion with no adverse comments. Standalone loss for the quarter ended 30th September 2026 was 1,970.89 lakh rupees. Standalone loss for the half year ended 30th September 2026 was 6,379.85 lakh rupees. Basic earnings per share was negative 6.28 rupees for the quarter. Total assets stood at 1,94,826.85 lakh rupees as at 30th September 2026. Equity was 1,86,658.56 lakh rupees. The results are subject to standard listing regulations.
